purpose: Collapse the recovered 21-phase/227-step internal Book lifecycle into 20 stable executable macro phases. The 227 steps remain subordinate planning/gate intelligence and may not create parallel product lifecycle states.
global_invariants: BOOK-COMP-05 owns lifecycle/gate/next-step truth; BOOK-COMP-02 alone owns canonical Book mutation.
The recovered 227 atomic steps are internal planning decomposition, not 227 executable states.
A phase can be skipped only by deterministic applicability evaluation to NOT_APPLICABLE; manual skip is forbidden.
NOT_APPLICABLE satisfies traversal but never masquerades as completed work.
BLOCKED, STALE, RECOVERY_REQUIRED and CANCELLED never satisfy a completion gate.
Completion requires all required inputs, all required decisions, the declared gate, exact-current source identity and an immutable completion receipt.
Material upstream change invalidates dependent completion evidence; stale evidence remains provenance only.
Reopen never rewrites a historical completion receipt.
Cancellation stops outstanding work only and never rolls back accepted canonical Book state.
Recovery starts from the latest valid canonical Book identity plus immutable checkpoint/evidence receipts.
Next-step selection is deterministic and always prefers the first applicable non-complete dependency-valid phase.
Author-required semantic or creative decisions cannot be synthesized by automation.
Technical artifact build does not imply release, distribution or submission authority.
REENTRY_EDITION creates a successor edition/lifecycle generation; released history is immutable.
Current macro order is authoritative even where it normalizes legacy ordering; explicit cross-phase invalidation prevents reordered quality phases from hiding stale evidence.

rules: Applicability is frozen per lifecycle version from the explicit project profile.
A false optional flag yields NOT_APPLICABLE, not COMPLETE.
A true optional phase cannot be bypassed by selecting a later phase.
Changing applicability creates a successor lifecycle version and recomputes readiness/staleness.
Existing-book recovery occurs inside INTAKE and computes maturity/exact-next; it does not force naive full replay.
REENTRY_EDITION is normally false until a correction/new-edition event is intentionally opened.
SUBMISSION_HANDOFF is target-driven; external transmission still requires explicit authority.

transition_model.normal_progression: COMPLETE -> first later applicable phase; false-applicability phases are NOT_APPLICABLE.
transition_model.block: READY|ACTIVE -> BLOCKED with blocker references; no downstream progression.
transition_model.unblock: BLOCKED -> READY after blocker disposition evidence and current source check.
transition_model.stale: READY|ACTIVE|BLOCKED|COMPLETE -> STALE on material dependency/source/authority change.
transition_model.reopen: COMPLETE|STALE|BLOCKED|CANCELLED|RECOVERY_REQUIRED -> READY under the phase reopen rule; dependent completions become STALE.
transition_model.cancel: READY|ACTIVE|BLOCKED|STALE|RECOVERY_REQUIRED -> CANCELLED with checkpoint; canonical/evidence state is preserved.
transition_model.recover: CANCELLED|RECOVERY_REQUIRED|STALE -> READY when checkpoint and exact-current source reconcile; otherwise remains STALE.
transition_model.reentry: REENTRY_EDITION COMPLETE creates a successor edition/lifecycle generation and chooses the earliest invalidated macro phase.
transition_model.terminal: Generation is COMPLETE when every applicable phase is COMPLETE and no successor reentry is pending.

next_step_algorithm: Validate contract, profile, lifecycle digest and source identity.
Walk phase_order and select the first applicable phase not COMPLETE.
Missing required input => PROVIDE_INPUT for first missing input in contract order.
Missing required decision => RESOLVE_DECISION for first unresolved decision in contract order.
ACTIVE with gate incomplete => EXECUTE_OPERATION for first unevidenced allowed operation.
Gate passed but completion receipt absent => SEAL_PHASE_COMPLETION.
After completion, recompute from the beginning; never assume the syntactically next phase applies.
No applicable incomplete phase => LIFECYCLE_COMPLETE unless a reentry successor is pending.

cross_phase_invalidation_rules.reason: Fact/citation correction changes accepted text after COPY; copy and later evidence require revalidation.
Rights remediation that changes content invalidates text-dependent checks and downstream artifacts.
Territory/channel changes can invalidate rights and release/distribution standing.
Caller selects the earliest affected macro phase; that phase and later dependent completion evidence become STALE.
External feedback is reconciled to the smallest affected lifecycle phase rather than replaying the whole book.

projection_groups.note: current macro order places COPY before FACT_CITATION/RIGHTS; backward invalidation handles later corrections
SUBMISSION_HANDOFF adds dedicated target/package/response semantics previously recorded as a residual; no false historical completion transfer

phases.title: Intake

reopen_rules.effect: reopen INTAKE and stale dependent downstream completions

cancellation.effect: preserve imported sources, accepted canonical state and receipts

recovery.effect: reconstruct intake; stale dependent work if source identity changed

phases.next_step_calculation: Resolve missing intake inputs/decisions; for recovered books compute maturity and select the first incomplete valid native gate.

phases.title: Intent

reopen_rules.effect: recompute applicability and stale dependent downstream completions

cancellation.effect: preserve governing brief versions and unresolved decisions

recovery.effect: restore last accepted intent or require renewed author decision

phases.next_step_calculation: Return unresolved author decision first; after gate choose the first applicable successor.

phases.title: Research

reopen_rules.effect: stale dependent knowledge/fact/citation and any downstream gate that consumed changed evidence

cancellation.effect: preserve acquired evidence/provenance and unresolved questions

recovery.effect: resume unresolved questions; stale evidence never becomes current silently

phases.next_step_calculation: Select highest-priority unresolved required research question; when sufficient, advance.

phases.title: Knowledge / Canon

reopen_rules.effect: stale architecture/content/edit phases consuming changed canon

cancellation.effect: preserve last ratified canon plus open questions

recovery.effect: restore last valid version then re-evaluate current conflicts

phases.next_step_calculation: Resolve material canon conflict/open decision first; otherwise ratify and advance.

phases.title: Architecture

reopen_rules.effect: stale UNIT_DESIGN and dependent content/edit gates

cancellation.effect: preserve prior plan versions and alternatives

recovery.effect: restore if inputs current; otherwise require re-ratification

phases.next_step_calculation: Resolve first invalid structural dependency/decision; after gate advance to UNIT_DESIGN.

phases.title: Unit Design

reopen_rules.effect: reopen affected units and stale their derived draft/edit evidence without forcing unrelated units stale

cancellation.effect: preserve completed unit designs and resumable incomplete units

recovery.effect: recover per-unit readiness and invalidate only changed dependencies

phases.next_step_calculation: Choose first dependency-valid required unit lacking complete design.

phases.title: Draft

reopen_rules.effect: reopen affected units and stale downstream review/edit evidence for changed text

cancellation.effect: preserve accepted canonical content; cancel only outstanding jobs/candidates

recovery.effect: resume only unaccepted/invalidated units against exact-current source

phases.next_step_calculation: Choose first dependency-valid unit without accepted current draft; provider absence is a blocker, never a bypass.

phases.title: Macro Revision

reopen_rules.effect: reopen MACRO or earlier ARCHITECTURE/UNIT_DESIGN; stale dependent edit phases

cancellation.effect: preserve findings and admitted revisions; cancel unadmitted candidates

recovery.effect: reuse findings only if exact-source binding remains current

phases.next_step_calculation: Return earliest unresolved material macro finding; structural findings reopen upstream structure rather than local patching.

phases.title: Developmental

reopen_rules.effect: reopen DEVELOPMENTAL; structural findings escalate to MACRO_REVISION

cancellation.effect: preserve findings/dispositions and admitted content

recovery.effect: revalidate source binding before reusing findings

phases.next_step_calculation: Resolve highest-severity current-source developmental finding; escalate structural findings upstream.

phases.title: Line / Style

reopen_rules.effect: stale COPY and later text-dependent checks

cancellation.effect: preserve accepted text and diagnostics; cancel pending suggestions

recovery.effect: old diagnostics are provenance only if text changed

phases.next_step_calculation: Resolve first material line/style finding on exact-current text; never auto-accept stylistic candidates.

phases.title: Copy

reopen_rules.effect: reopen COPY for affected scope and stale proof/build evidence

cancellation.effect: preserve resolved queries/style sheet; cancel pending diagnostics

recovery.effect: reuse only findings whose exact text remains current

phases.next_step_calculation: Resolve first material copy finding/query; when none remain, complete gate.

phases.title: Fact / Citation

reopen_rules.effect: reopen affected claims; accepted corrections that change text invalidate COPY and later text-dependent phases

cancellation.effect: preserve claim/source provenance and unresolved verification queue

recovery.effect: recompute freshness and exact claim binding

phases.next_step_calculation: Verify highest-risk unresolved required claim/citation first; prior-manuscript verification never transfers silently.

phases.title: Rights

reopen_rules.effect: reopen affected rights; content replacement/removal invalidates COPY/FACT/PROOF/build

cancellation.effect: preserve license evidence; cancellation never implies permission

recovery.effect: revalidate scope/term against current edition and distribution targets

phases.next_step_calculation: Resolve first blocking rights item; uncleared required material prevents release authority.

phases.title: Proof

reopen_rules.effect: reopen PROOF and earliest upstream quality gate affected by substantive change

cancellation.effect: preserve last proofed version; do not promote it to release candidate

recovery.effect: resume only if proof source is exact-current

phases.next_step_calculation: Resolve first proof blocker/error; substantive changes route back to earliest affected gate.

phases.title: Publication Build

reopen_rules.effect: reopen build; substantive content changes reopen earliest affected content/quality phase

cancellation.effect: preserve immutable built artifacts/manifests; cancel outstanding builds

recovery.effect: reuse only exact-source/exact-profile artifacts

phases.next_step_calculation: Build/validate first missing required artifact or metadata set; successful export never implies release authorization.

phases.title: Release

reopen_rules.effect: reopen before external effect; distributed releases use edition/reentry rather than silent replacement

cancellation.effect: before release cancel authorization; after immutable receipt use withdrawal/edition path

recovery.effect: re-evaluate prerequisites; never synthesize approval

phases.next_step_calculation: Return missing release authority/prerequisite first; release only on explicit current approval.

phases.title: Distribution

reopen_rules.effect: reopen only affected targets; never mutate prior external receipts

cancellation.effect: stop future transmissions where possible; preserve irreversible external receipts

recovery.effect: reconcile external reality before retry; avoid duplicate side effects

phases.next_step_calculation: Choose first authorized unresolved target; absent authority means wait, not transmit.

phases.title: Preservation

reopen_rules.effect: reopen for new exact subject; prior preservation receipt remains immutable provenance

cancellation.effect: preserve completed immutable backup artifacts; cancel outstanding durability jobs

recovery.effect: verify last complete set then fill missing current-subject preservation work

phases.next_step_calculation: Preserve newest exact canonical/release subject lacking a valid restore-tested preservation receipt.

phases.title: Reentry / Edition

reopen_rules.effect: recompute reopen boundary and applicability in successor edition only

cancellation.effect: prior edition remains immutable; cancel only successor-edition work

recovery.effect: reconstruct successor lineage without mutating prior edition

phases.next_step_calculation: Choose earliest phase invalidated by edition scope; successor generation resumes there rather than replaying everything.

phases.title: Submission / Handoff

reopen_rules.effect: create new handoff attempt; never rewrite prior transmission receipts

cancellation.effect: stop pending transmission where possible; preserve irreversible submission receipts

recovery.effect: reconcile external outcome before retry to avoid duplicate submission

phases.next_step_calculation: Satisfy first unmet recipient/package requirement; transmit only with explicit authority; otherwise produce handoff-ready package without side effect.
